name: Attorney-General's Chambers

scam_info.sample: The Attorney-General’s Chambers (“AGC”) has been alerted to a scam letter that was received by a member of the public overseas bearing the AGC letterhead and a signature of an officer allegedly from the AGC.
scam_info.notes: The scam letter scan is in an attached PDF (311 KB, not downloaded). Fee demand tied to a "money laundering matter".

scam_info.notes: Fake-PMO-webpage hoax (2015). Relevant to PMO impersonation history.
